digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler backend port / vendor adapter seam
propositions: Four core modules (fetcher.py, applier.py, apply_handlers.py, _attestation.py) contain nested or module-level imports from adapters.jira that must be removed to satisfy the vendor-neutral port contract.

The Backend protocol must expose scalar, read-only members (project, query_project, assert_env_ready) and neutral exception types (BackendEnvError, BackendAssigneeNotFoundError) to enable vendors to provide environment/scope information without parameterization on vendor shapes.

JiraBackend must implement the new Backend protocol members by delegating to resolve_jira_settings, preserving existing semantics including DIG default in applier, fail-closed behavior in fetcher, and JIRA_* attestation in environment checks.
An AST walker must validate at test time that all four modules contain zero adapters.jira imports at any nesting depth, including lazy imports within function bodies.
The S2 contract suite and FakeBackend must be updated to satisfy the widened Backend protocol, ensuring structural typing verification and preventing out-of-tree implementor breakage.
